description: Duplicate, delete (with a replacement style), move or copy styles into a style group, for any kind of style (Duplicate Style, Delete Style, Copy to Group in the Paragraph, Character, Object, Table and Cell Styles panels); and turn a paragraph style's bullets and numbering into text

action.description: What to do with each style

group.description: move_to_group / copy_to_group: style group path, created when missing; "" for the top level

newName.description: duplicate: name for the copy (one style only); without it InDesign names the copy

replaceWith.description: delete: the style that replaces the deleted one where it is used: a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

name: manage_styles
title: Manage Styles
